Subject: Follow-up: Procurement & Marketplace path - LumenAI

Hi Alex - great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary:
- Primary use-case: internal document understanding and multi-turn search for support agents.
- Expected avg request size: 300 tokens, bursty traffic during business hours.
- Target go-live: late April (pilot) -> production Q3 if pilot goes well.

Procurement questions we discussed (asking to confirm):
1) Preferred commercial path: card vs PO vs AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace?
2) Procurement contact for invoicing / legal redlines (if PO preferred).
3) Any internal SLAs or required contract language (e.g., data residency, audit rights)?

Attachments: I've attached our current Dedicated pricing and a short marketplace onboarding checklist so you can see options for direct PO vs marketplace procurement.

Suggested next steps:
- Alex / Procurement: confirm preferred billing path (PO vs card vs AWS Marketplace) and share procurement contact.
- We'll prepare either: a) DocuSign MSA + SOW for PO; or b) Marketplace listing specs and partner onboarding steps for AWS/GCP.
- Quick sync next week if useful (15-20 min).

Thanks - I'll leave Procurement on this thread so we capture the right contact details.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Procurement & Marketplace path - LumenAI

Thanks Camila - solid recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Preferred path: We'd like to pursue AWS Marketplace first (helps with internal billing and simplifies procurement), but we may need a parallel PO route if marketplace onboarding takes too long.
- Procurement contact: procurement@lumenai.com (CC'd). Our procurement lead is Maya Patel and she'll handle PO terms and standard POs.
- Timeline: pilot sign-off mid-April; procurement needs to have either marketplace listing live or a signed PO by end of April.
- Contract notes: we'll need standard indemnity language and an SOC2 attestation - can you share SOC2 scope?

Questions for you: Does Redwood support transactable listings on AWS Marketplace (metered billing/prorated monthly), and can we sign a PO against a DocuSign MSA if marketplace isn't ready?

Appreciate it - feel free to bring in whoever from your partnerships team if needed.

Best,
Alex
Director of Platform Products | LumenAI
alex.carter@lumenai.com

Thanks for the context. Short answers: 

- Yes - we support AWS Marketplace transactable listings with metered billing and prorated first invoices. Partner team will need to provision the listing; that typically takes 2-3 weeks for onboarding if we have materials ready.
- PO fallback is fine - we can execute a DocuSign MSA + SOW and invoice net 30.
- Discounting: for marketplace-enabled pilots we typically offer a 10% pilot discount (applied to first three months or first $X spend) - recommend we propose that to LumenAI.
- SOC2: we can share our SOC2 Type II attestation PDF; will attach once I get the latest version from security.

Next steps (proposal):
1) Camila: introduce LumenAI procurement contact to our partnerships onboarding (I'll include a partner onboarding checklist and a short intro template).
2) I'll prepare a DocuSign MSA + SOW draft with the pricing in the attached PDF and mark the pilot discount.
3) If LumenAI opts for AWS Marketplace, we'll kick off partner onboarding and share the expected listing date (2-3 weeks).

Camila - want me to send the DocuSign to procurement@lumenai.com and cc you, or would you prefer to make the intro first?

-Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments (will provide shortly): SOC2_TypeII_Redwood.pdf
